Caste Certificate — Apply Online Guide

• Last updated: 2026-09-15 · 3 min read
Share:
In simple words:

Caste Certificate state government dwara issue kiya jaata hai aur yeh prove karta hai ki aap kaunsi caste category (SC/ST/OBC) se belong karte hain. Education admission, government jobs, aur reservation benefits ke liye yeh zaroori document hai.

S
Samjho Content Team ✓

Trusted and policy experts simplifying MSME, tax, and compliance for India. Verified by Chartered Accountants.

Simple explanation

Caste Certificate ek official document hai jo certify karta hai ki aap SC (Scheduled Caste), ST (Scheduled Tribe), ya OBC (Other Backward Class) category se belong karte hain. Yeh Revenue Department (Tehsildar / SDM) issue karta hai.

Caste certificate 3 main categories ke liye hota hai: SC — jo Scheduled Castes list mein aate hain (Constitution order 1950), ST — jo Scheduled Tribes list mein aate hain, aur OBC — jo Central ya State OBC list mein notified hain. Har state ki apni list hoti hai.

Apply karne ke liye apne state ke e-District portal par jaayein ya nearest CSC / Tehsil office. Form bharein, documents upload karein, fees pay karein. Required documents: Aadhaar, parents ka caste certificate (agar pehle se hai), school records, aur self-declaration.

Caste certificate ki validity: SC/ST ke liye usually lifetime validity hoti hai (jab tak state change na ho). OBC ke liye kuch states mein annual renewal lagta hai, especially Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate jo har saal renew hota hai.

Why does it matter?

Caste certificate reservation policy ke under benefits access karne ke liye zaroori hai — government job vacancies mein reserved seats, education institutions mein quota, scholarship schemes, aur kai welfare programmes. Bina valid caste certificate ke aap in benefits claim nahi kar sakte.

Example

In numbers

Aap OBC category se hain aur engineering college mein OBC quota seat ke liye apply karna chahte hain. Aap e-District portal par caste certificate ke liye apply karte hain — father ka caste certificate, school records, aur Aadhaar upload karte hain. Tehsildar verify karta hai aur 15-30 din mein certificate mil jaata hai. Yeh certificate admission form mein lagta hai.

Important things to know

  • Caste Certificate Revenue Department (Tehsildar/SDM) issue karta hai — state government ke under.
  • 3 main categories: SC (Scheduled Caste), ST (Scheduled Tribe), OBC (Other Backward Class).
  • Apply online: e-District portal ya nearest CSC / Tehsil office se.
  • Required documents: Aadhaar, parents ka caste certificate (primary proof), school records, self-declaration.
  • SC/ST certificate: Usually lifetime validity. OBC certificate: Kuch states mein annual renewal.
  • Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate: OBC ke liye alag se chahiye — family income ₹8 lakh se kam honi chahiye. Har saal renew hota hai.
  • Fees: Nominal (₹10-₹50). Processing time: 15-30 din.
  • Central list aur State list alag hain — job ke liye Central list, state benefits ke liye State list ka certificate chahiye.

Common mistakes

  • Galat category select karna — SC, ST, OBC mein se apni exact category choose karein. Galat category se certificate invalid ho jaata hai.
  • Parents ka caste certificate na dena — yeh sabse important proof hai. Agar parents ka certificate nahi hai toh process mushkil hota hai.
  • Inter-state caste mismatch — aapki caste jis state mein notified hai, doosri state mein shayad nahi hai. Central vs State list check karein.
  • NCL certificate bhool jaana — OBC reservation ke liye sirf caste certificate kaafi nahi, Non-Creamy Layer certificate bhi chahiye.
  • School records mein caste galat likhi hona — pehle check karein ki school records mein caste sahi hai, warna pehle school se correction karwayein.

Frequently asked questions

Caste certificate ke liye online apply kaise karein?

Apne state ke e-District portal par jaayein. 'Caste Certificate' service select karein, form bharein (personal details, caste details, family details). Parents ka caste certificate, Aadhaar, school records upload karein. Fees pay karein. Reference number se status track ho sakta hai.

Caste certificate ke liye kaunse documents lagte hain?

Aadhaar card, parents ka caste certificate (sabse important), school leaving certificate / TC jisme caste likhi ho, address proof, self-declaration affidavit. Agar parents ka certificate nahi hai toh revenue records (land records, old voter list) se prove karna pad sakta hai.

Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate kya hai?

NCL certificate OBC candidates ke liye zaroori hai jo reservation benefits chahte hain. Yeh prove karta hai ki aapki family 'creamy layer' mein nahi aati — annual family income ₹8 lakh se kam honi chahiye. Har financial year mein renew hota hai. Tehsildar / SDM office se milta hai.

Caste certificate ki validity kitni hai?

SC/ST certificate: Usually lifetime validity hoti hai. OBC certificate: State-wise vary — kuch states mein lifetime, kuch mein 1 saal. NCL certificate: Har saal renew hota hai. Job application ya admission ke time current validity check karein.

Caste certificate kitne din mein banta hai?

Normally 15-30 din lagte hain. Verification process mein time lagta hai — revenue officials documents check karte hain aur kabhi field verification bhi hoti hai. Online apply karne par status track ho sakta hai.

Agar meri caste state list mein hai lekin central list mein nahi, toh kya hoga?

Central government jobs aur education institutions ke liye Central list ka certificate chahiye. State government benefits ke liye State list ka certificate kaam aata hai. Dono lists alag hain — pehle check karein ki aapki caste kis list mein notified hai.
